In time, she vows to confront the giants who held her and make them regret keeping her. Myzrael calls you a noble ally and says she will need your aid again in time. When ready, she will have you summon her to the surface. For now, she sends you to Zaruk in Hammerfall, who knows how it can be done.

quest:692.text: The Lost Fragments. Behind Theldurin, furious elementals fight over scraps of the Scroll of Myzrael. You gather the torn pieces while he fears what its magic might do. Theldurin the Lost fears the Scroll of Myzrael could draw Myzrael up to the surface. Then he considers another danger. She may already be free, or gathering strength to strike. If so, the scroll may be what you need to bind her again. Furious elementals took the scroll and tore it apart. Now they fight over its scraps in the hills behind Theldurin. Bring back three pieces: one torn, one crumpled and one singed. Theldurin hopes to mend them.

quest:698.text: Lack of Surplus. Dar needs more sawtooth meat for the eastern beach outpost. Tok'Kar has little time between guard shifts and cooking for the soldiers, so Dar asks you to bring some. Dar is gathering supplies for the outpost on the eastern beach. Tok'Kar guards the post and cooks for its soldiers, leaving little time for other work. The soldiers enjoy sawtooth meat when they can get it. Dar has not had time to send another shipment. Older sawtooths taste better, Dar says, so leave the young ones alone. They need a year or two to reach full size. Bring eight unprepared sawtooth flanks to Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quest:699.text: Lack of Surplus. Along the coast, Tok'Kar and his soldiers watch for murlocs threatening Stonard. When the force grows too large, they send warning; for now, Tok'Kar asks you to bring six sawtooth snapper claws. Tok'Kar and the soldiers guard Stonard from murlocs along the coast. When the force is too large to face, they warn the town. Tok'Kar has little time to rest, so he asks you to help. Properly prepared, sawtooth snapper claws make fine weapons. Bring him six, and he offers one of the outpost's weapons in return, grateful for the meat and company.

quest:7003.text:
Zapped Giants. On Feralas's Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle tests a shrinking ray on the giants near the docks. He built it from a gnomish design and improved it with goblin know-how, then gives you the Ultra-Shrinker to try on Feralas's giants. Zorbin Fandazzle needs the giants of Feralas dealt with so he can stay and keep his business. His answer is a shrinking ray based on a gnomish design, improved with what he calls superior goblin advances. He would rather you test it than risk his own life.

Use the Ultra-Shrinker on Cliff Giants, Deep Striders, Wave Striders, Shore Striders or Land Walkers. Gather the miniaturization residue left behind when they shrink, then bring it back to the docks. Zorbin calls miniaturization residue valuable in engineering. It helps keep a zapper from exploding on its user. Then he adds that this applies only to other zappers, not the one in your hands.

quest:703.text: Barbecued Buzzard Wings. Rigglefuzz has every ingredient for his barbecued buzzard wings except the wings themselves. Rigglefuzz takes pride in his barbecued buzzard wings. He coats the tangy meat in rich sauce, and its aroma carries to hungry folk nearby. He has all the ingredients for a batch but the wings. Bring him four buzzard wings, and he may share the recipe.

quest:706.text: Fiery Blaze Enchantments. A rare black drake whelp's still-beating heart is needed for Fiery Blaze Enchantments in the Badlands. Sigrun Ironhew waits for word from Ironforge, and the whelps of Lethlor Ravine may supply what she needs. Sigrun Ironhew learned to kindle fire on weapons while apprenticed to Feranor Steeltoe. Feranor was last heard of among the smiths of a hunting party in Lordaeron. Sigrun waits in the Badlands for word from Ironforge. She has little else to do. Sigrun shares little about the process. It calls for blood from the still-beating heart of a rare black drake whelp. Bring her a heart from a whelp in Lethlor Ravine, and she will show you the skill. The Scalding Whelps and Scorched Guardians there yield the hearts.

quest:708.text: The Black Box. A giant condor in the Badlands swallowed a black box marked for Ironforge. After ages in the condor's stomach, acid had pitted the metal. A symbol marks the underside above the words Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade. You carry the box to Pilot Longbeard in Ironforge's Hall of Arms.

quest:712.text:
Study of the Elements: Rock. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus needs bracers from greater rock elementals to judge his shackles. Lotwil Veriatus needs one last part from the Badlands' elementals, after the stone slabs. Bracers of rock binding from greater rock elementals will help him judge the shackles under construction.

His scrying found a group southwest, near some ogres, if memory serves. He asks for five bracers so there will be spares, since Servo often misplaces reagents and research.

quest:716.text: Stone Is Better than Cloth. In the Badlands, Lucien Tosselwrench has a gift for you, though his work is not finished. The extra stones you gathered are ready, but he still needs patterned bronze bracers. After your work for Lotwil on his third Study of the Elements: Rock request, Lucien Tosselwrench admits Lotwil can be cheap. He means to make it up to you with fine enchanted bracers fashioned from the extra stones you gathered. They may help guard you against the coming atrocity of Lotwil's newest invention. To finish the bracers, Lucien needs patterned bronze bracers of the kind a blacksmith makes. He warns you not to wait long. No one knows what happens next.

quest:717.text: Tremors of the Earth. At Lethlor, Garek fears the drakes may break free. Black dragons now dwell there, and ogres have taken the Sign of the Earth. So he sends you to free the drakes and kill them. At Lethlor, Garek fears Blacklash and Hematus may escape their prison. Black dragons now dwell there, and ogres have taken the Sign of the Earth. Garek sees no safer course. The drakes must die. Three runestones hold the drakes, and the Sign of the Earth is needed to release them. You use the Sign at the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal and Diamond, then place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth. Blacklash and Hematus are freed, and you slay them. Garek asks you to bring back Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus and the Sign of the Earth.

quest:723.text: Prospect of Faith. In the Badlands, Hammertoe Grez sends you to Prospector Ryedol with his amulet. Ryedol knows Hammertoe sought the origins of their people and wants to keep the scrolls from the Shadowforge clan. Wounded in the Badlands, Hammertoe Grez asks you to carry his amulet to Ryedol. He trusts Ryedol to know what to do. Hammertoe sought the origins of their people and meant to thwart the Shadowforge clan. The clan must not get the scrolls.

quest:724.text: Prospect of Faith. In the Badlands, Prospector Ryedol sends you to Ironforge with Hammertoe's Amulet. Historian Karnik and Hammertoe sought Uldaman's lost artifacts together. Ryedol suspects the Shadowforge learned they knew more than they let on. Prospector Ryedol sends you to Historian Karnik in Ironforge. Tell Karnik what happened to Hammertoe and place the amulet in his hands. Karnik will decide what to do next.

quest:725.text:
Passing Word of a Threat. Karnik sends you to Advisor Belgrum with a sealed note. Tell Belgrum what you witnessed and ask how to proceed while Karnik seeks answers from Hammertoe's spirit. Historian Karnik needs you to reach Advisor Belgrum quickly. Tell him what you witnessed and ask how he wants to proceed. The sealed note explains more.

Meanwhile, Karnik speaks with Hammertoe's spirit, hoping to learn how to end the Shadowforge's doings in the Badlands. He can only pray that Hammertoe knows something that will help.

quest:726.text: Passing Word of a Threat. In the Badlands, Belgrum sends you back to Karnik with the king's command to act swiftly against the Shadowforge. Belgrum reads Karnik's note to the end. His eyes widen at the evil tidings. He sends you back to Karnik with the king's command: act swiftly and decisively on what is known. The Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands must stop.

quest:727.text: To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest. Theldurin the Lost sends you to Ironforge with a sigil. In a shop in the Forlorn Cavern, Gerrig Bonegrip is meant to take you for one of the people Theldurin fled, so you can ask him for Yagyin's Digest. The Tablet has taught Theldurin much, yet questions remain. Yagyin wrote a digest ages ago, and the people Theldurin fled keep copies in many places. Their most learned study it. Theldurin believes its vast knowledge can offer protection, so he wants you to bring it back. Gerrig Bonegrip keeps a shop in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show Gerrig. Then Gerrig should take you for one of the people Theldurin fled. Ask him for Yagyin's Digest.

quest:728.text: To the Undercity for Yagyin's Digest. Theldurin the Lost sends you to the Undercity of Lordaeron with a sigil for Keeper Bel'dugur. He wants the keeper to mistake you for one of the people he fled, and asks you to find Yagyin's Digest. The tablet has answered much for Theldurin, yet questions remain. Yagyin wrote a digest ages ago, and the people Theldurin fled keep copies in many places. Their most learned study its pages. Theldurin believes its vast knowledge can protect them, so he wants you to bring it back. Keeper Bel'dugur waits in the Undercity of Lordaeron. Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show the keeper, who is to take you for one of the people he fled. Ask Bel'dugur for the digest.

quest:732.text: Tremors of the Earth. Garek asks for your help after hearing all you have done for Sigrun. His master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, sent him to the Badlands to stop trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine. First, he needs the stolen Sign of the Earth. Krasus of the Kirin Tor sent Garek to the Badlands to stop trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine. He cannot tell you the exact assignment, only that it matters greatly. Roving ogres took the Sign of the Earth, and Garek needs it back before he can tell you more. They are sometimes seen around Camp Boff. Ogres wander from camp to camp across the Badlands. Rising heat and swirling winds make their trail hard to follow. Garek has heard they sometimes pass through Camp Boff, so look there if you lose track of them.

quest:733.text: Scrounging. At Sigrun Ironhew's camp, defenses and supplies wait on scrap metal. She needs seven pieces, and nearby ogres carry plenty. Sigrun Ironhew needs materials for the camp's defenses and other needs. The Prospector worries about the camp's condition, so Sigrun wants to begin work soon. Scrap metal is what she lacks. Nearby ogres carry scrap metal, adding weight to talk of siege engines in the Badlands. Their main camp, Dustbelch Grotto, lies a long trek west of Sigrun's camp.

quest:734.text: This Is Going to Be Hard. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench for a needed cog #5. Bring it back to Lotwil. Lotwil Veriatus turns his attention to the shackles, then sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench. He needs a cog #5 and asks you to bring it back to him.

quest:735.text: The Star, the Hand and the Heart. In Ironforge, Gerrig Bonegrip offers Yagyin's Digest in exchange for three items of power. Their names are kept from listening ears and written in a note. Gerrig Bonegrip hears you ask for Yagyin's Digest and wonders whether you mean to begin a new chapter of the order somewhere. Gerrig decides it is not their place to ask. With an extra copy on hand, Gerrig believes those of the order should aid one another. So Gerrig asks you to bring three items of power. Their names stay unspoken in case someone is listening, and Gerrig writes them down. Gerrig's note names the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart. Gerrig wants all three before handing over Yagyin's Digest.

quest:737.text: Forbidden Knowledge. Yagyin's Digest is in your care, bound for Theldurin the Lost and kept from unfriendly hands. Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge or Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity gives you Yagyin's Digest. Keep it from unfriendly hands as you carry it to Theldurin the Lost. It holds many truths, and truth has a way of burning.

quest:739.text: Murdaloc. Agmond lies dead in the Badlands, with Murdaloc scratched into the sandstone beside his hand. Slay his killer and carry word to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan. Blood marks Agmond's trail from the west, crossing stone and sand. It shows how far the dwarf crawled before he died. Beside his still hand, one word is scratched into the Badlands sandstone: Murdaloc. Slay Agmond's killer and a number of Stonevault Bonesnappers, then carry the news to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

quest:7541.text: Service to the Horde. In Orgrimmar, Zor Lonetree has received the jeweled pendant and has more to tell you about your service to the Horde. The jeweled pendant now rests with Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar. Return to him to hear more about your service to the Horde.

quest:762.text: An Ambassador of Evil. In the Badlands, Historian Karnik sends you after Ambassador Infernus. He wants you to carry proof of the kill to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge. Ragnaros sent Ambassador Infernus to Angor Fortress to oversee the Shadowforge's hunt for lost artifacts in Uldaman. The search has already cost many dwarven lives, and more are dying. Karnik fears the Shadowforge could turn the artifacts against Ironforge. So he sends you back into the Badlands to destroy Infernus and carry Belgrum proof of your victory. Time is short. Ragnaros will not wait for the Shadowforge to prepare.

quest:77.text: A Sticky Situation. Dran Droffers seeks the original packaging for Hinterlands Honey Ripple. Gilveradin Sunchaser has it and asks for two extra bottles; ten bottles wait in crates around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock. Dran Droffers seeks Hinterlands Honey Ripple, and Gilveradin Sunchaser has its original packaging. Gilveradin offers to help in return for two extra bottles. Gather ten bottles and bring them back to the camp. Crates of Hinterlands Honey Ripple are scattered around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock. Foul slimes and oozes cling to the ruins. Rumor says a master ooze leads them.

quest:7701.text: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius. In the Cauldron, a bounty calls for Overseer Maltorius's death. It names him a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent and the newly hired commander of the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew. Overseer Oilfist orders his head brought to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker as proof. In the Cauldron's Slag Pit, you are sent to find and slay Overseer Maltorius. The notice calls him a traitorous Dark Iron dwarf. Bring his head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker to claim the bounty.

quest:7704.text: Look at the Size of It!. In the Searing Gorge, you have a gigantic, ornate pillow once kept by Chambermaid Pillaclencher. Evonice Sootsmoker is sure to want it. Evonice Sootsmoker is sure to want Chambermaid Pillaclencher's gigantic, ornate pillow. Bring it to her in the Searing Gorge and see what she offers for your trouble.

quest:7721.text: Fuel for the Zapping. On the Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle puts his engineering shop to work in a poor place. The elementals trouble him, but their water cores can power the refining of the Ultra-Shrinker. Zorbin Fandazzle curses the unchecked power of elementalism and calls the coast's elementals pests. Yet he sees their water elemental cores as raw power for refining the Ultra-Shrinker. He asks you to fight the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the coast. Keep their cores and bring them to him by the dock.

quest:7722.text: What the Flux?. Master Smith Burninate seeks the fiery flux plans in the Slag Pit. Maltorius left their clan with the recipe, which Burninate values above a pristine arcane crystal, and believes the plans are near him. Master Smith Burninate says Maltorius betrayed their clan when he left with the fiery flux recipe. Burninate suspects that recipe helped Maltorius earn his new promotion among the Dark Irons. Now Burninate wants the secret plans returned. Master Smith Burninate believes the plans lie near Maltorius, deep in the Slag Pit. He wants you to carry the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux back to him.

quest:7723.text: Curse These Fat Fingers. In the Searing Gorge, Hansel Heavyhands can no longer deliver beatings as before. Swollen fingers leave Hansel asking you to pound the heavy war golems instead. Hansel Heavyhands blames the Searing Gorge climate and its thin air for swelling their fingers. They resemble huge Thelsamar blood sausages. With fingers like these, Hansel can no longer deliver beatings as before, so they need you to handle their business. Hansel wants you to pound the Gorge's heavy war golems hard. Twenty must be destroyed. They roam the areas around the Cauldron, and you return to Hansel once enough have fallen.

quest:7724.text: Fiery Menace!. Hansel Heavyhands has another job for you in the Searing Gorge. Greater lava spiders are making trouble. Hansel Heavyhands has little time to rest or think on his life. Those in power keep giving him more work. Greater lava spiders are causing a ruckus, so Hansel would rather you deal with them. Oilfist says the greater lava spiders shoot fire from an awkward place. Their flames upset the children. Hansel wants you to kill twenty spiders on the plateaus and by the lava pools of the Searing Gorge.

quest:7725.text:
Again With the Zapped Giants. At the Forgotten Coast docks, Zorbin Fandazzle has another offer for you. Bring him more residue from Feralas giants shrunk with the Ultra-Shrinker. He can pay far less this time, but promises to spread word of your service. Zorbin Fandazzle asks you to shrink giants in Feralas again and bring ten miniaturization residues to the Forgotten Coast docks. There is always room for more, even after your first haul.

He cannot offer nearly as much this time. Instead, he promises to praise your service among his goblin friends, who have quite large ears.

quest:7726.text:
Refuel for the Zapping. On the Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle needs more water elemental cores. The shop is hard to establish, so the pay is small. Still, Zorbin promises to tell nearby folk of your help and says there are friends in the Cartel. Zorbin Fandazzle makes light of the heroic work of gathering goo from elemental beings. Then Zorbin asks if you want more of the same. Beneath the jest, Zorbin needs more water elemental cores.

Establishing a shop on the Forgotten Coast is a desperate business, so little can be given in return. Zorbin promises to tell everyone nearby how you helped, and says the promise is worth trusting because Zorbin knows people in the Cartel. Bring six cores from Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays on the Forgotten Coast to Zorbin near the dock.

quest:7727.text: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It. Hansel Heavyhands cannot fight with his feet in such disarray. So he sends you to slay twenty incendosaurs in the Slag Pit, where Scrange and Burninate want the lava pools cleared for expeditionary teams. Hansel Heavyhands cannot fight while his bunions are in such a state. Scrange and Burninate told him to kill the incendosaurs so expeditionary teams can explore the Slag Pit’s lava pools. Now he sends you in his place. The incendosaurs occupy the lava pools in the Slag Pit, within the Cauldron. Hansel wants twenty slain before you return.

quest:7728.text: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass. In the Searing Gorge, the Thorium Brotherhood seeks two stolen tools: a tuyere and a Lookout's Spyglass. The Brotherhood is certain jealous, unscrupulous Dark Iron dwarves took them, and asks that whoever finds them bring them to Taskmaster Scrange for payment. The Thorium Brotherhood seeks a Lookout's Spyglass and a tuyere, both stolen. The spyglass is a fine tool for lookouts, and the tuyere is a smithing tool that cannot be replaced. The Brotherhood is certain Dark Iron dwarves took them. Whoever finds the tools should bring them to Taskmaster Scrange.

quest:7729.text: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition. In the Searing Gorge, Taskmaster Scrange wants you to thin the competition through bloody work. Taskmaster Scrange sends you through the gorge to kill fifteen Dark Iron Taskmasters and fifteen Dark Iron Slavers. Return when your clothes are bloody enough. You will know when that is, and you are not to ask.

quest:7730.text: Zukk'ash Infestation. At Camp Mojache, Hadoken Swiftstrider suspects the Zukk'ash south of the gnolls are driving them into a frenzy. He sends you to the Writhing Deep to thin their numbers and return with twenty carapaces. Hadoken Swiftstrider believes insect-like creatures live south of the gnolls. Whether they can think matters little to him. If they drive the gnolls into a frenzy against Camp Mojache, they threaten the camp as much as the gnolls do. So you enter their home, the Writhing Deep, to thin their numbers. Bring back twenty Zukk'ash carapaces as proof, and tell Hadoken what you find.

quest:7731.text: Stinglasher. In the Writhing Deep, Hadoken Swiftstrider's scout has found an insect far larger than the others. A scout has found a giant insect wandering the twisted terrain of the Writhing Deep. It seems to give off an aura unlike the others, and Hadoken Swiftstrider has named it Stinglasher. Hadoken wants its secretion glands brought straight to Camp Mojache. By studying the insect's innards, Hadoken hopes to learn how to deal with this new threat.

quest:7732.text: Zukk'ash Report. At Camp Mojache, Hadoken Swiftstrider says your work against the Zukk'ash has gone doubly well, though danger remains. He asks you to carry the camp's report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar. Hadoken Swiftstrider has a document about what Camp Mojache has learned of the Zukk'ash insects. Their threat remains, so he asks you to take the report to Orgrimmar. Zilzibin Drumlore lives in the Drag and knows alien creatures like these. Hadoken hopes the camp's findings will prove useful.

quest:7733.text: Improved Quality. In northern Feralas, Pratt McGrubben wants tougher yeti hides from Rage Scar Hold. He asks you to bring ten to Feathermoon Stronghold. After The Mark of Quality, Pratt McGrubben has found finer hides. A tougher throng of yetis lives inside Rage Scar Hold in northern Feralas. Bring ten hides to Pratt at Feathermoon Stronghold, and he will pay handsomely. If these hides match the Feral Scar hides, they may prove as resilient as thorium.

quest:7734.text: Improved Quality. At Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider now seeks finer hides from the tougher yetis in Rage Scar Hold. After The Mark of Quality, Jangdor Swiftstrider has found a better source of hides. Tougher yetis roam inside Rage Scar Hold in northern Feralas. Bring ten hides to Camp Mojache, and Jangdor will pay handsomely. If they match the Feral Scar hides, they may prove as resilient as thorium.

quest:7735.text: Pristine Yeti Hide. In Feralas, a hide from Rage Scar's yetis may catch Pratt McGrubben's eye. It is unusually thick and tough, and Pratt is looking to buy yeti hides. Among the hides from Rage Scar's yetis, this one is unusually thick and sturdy. Pratt McGrubben wants to buy yeti hides at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas, so this hide may interest him.

quest:7736.text: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood. In the Searing Gorge, Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux after What the Flux?. He asks you for incendosaur scales, Kingsblood, and coal, and accepts all you can offer. Master Smith Burninate has little time for talk. His fiery flux is running low, so he asks you for two incendosaur scales, four Kingsblood, and coal. He will take all you can offer.

quest:7738.text: Perfect Yeti Hide. At Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider is buying yeti hides, and one you found may be perfect. It is thicker and tougher than the hides from the yetis of Rage Scar. The hide feels thicker and sturdier than those from the yetis of Rage Scar. Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache in Feralas buys yeti hides. This one is worth bringing to him.

quest:777.text: This Is Going to Be Hard. Behind cover, Lucien Tosselwrench waits while you carry cog #5 to Lotwil Veriatus. Lucien Tosselwrench gives you the cog for Lotwil Veriatus. Then he waits behind cover and welcomes you to join him. Lotwil is still bent over the shackles when you arrive. Without looking up, he holds out his hand and waggles his fingers for the cog.

quest:778.text: This Is Going to Be Hard. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus is ready to summon a powerful elemental. Lotwil calls out that the shackles are finished. The time has come. He asks Lucien and Servo to witness the summoning with you. Alchemy, engineering and the arcane come together in the shackles, and Lotwil expects a powerful elemental to answer on this groundbreaking day.

quest:7810.text: Arena Master. At the Stranglethorn Arena, Short John Mithril may know what more mastering its contests requires. You have gained something at Gurubashi, yet mastering the arena asks for more. Short John Mithril organizes the contests and may know what is needed. Find him inside the Stranglethorn Arena.

quest:7815.text: Snapjaws, Mon!. In Revantusk Village, Katoom the Angler asks you to deal with saltwater snapjaws ruining his fishing. He wants fifteen turtles killed. Katoom the Angler asks you to help him and his neighbours in Revantusk Village. Saltwater snapjaws may look harmless, but they make fishing hard. One tears his line and steals his bait before he can fish for five minutes. Katoom wants you to kill fifteen of the turtles.

quest:7816.text: Gammerita, Mon!. At Revantusk Village, Katoom the Angler wants his best lure back from Gammerita, Mon!, who leads the saltwater snapjaws. Find her and recover it. Katoom says Gammerita, Mon! is no ordinary turtle. She leads the saltwater snapjaws, and he calls her a thief. She snapped his best lure off his line. Since then, the fish have not bitten as they once did. Katoom wants you to find Gammerita, Mon! and recover his lure from her stomach. She stays along the coast among the other turtles.

quest:782.text:
Broken Alliances. Gorn sends you from Kargath to reclaim what the ogres took. He seeks to restore the Horde’s honor after its alliance with Deathwing. Boss Tho’grun, hired to find the Sign of the Earth, betrayed the Horde and kept it. During the Second War, the Horde fought beside Deathwing. His lieutenants Blacklash and Hematus were later imprisoned far to the east in Lethlor Ravine. Gorn believes these old, depraved allies must be silenced to restore the Horde’s honor.

The Horde needed the Sign of the Earth to open the drakes’ prison, so it hired ogre mercenaries led by Boss Tho’grun to find the sign. Tho’grun turned against the Horde, overwhelmed its forces and kept it. Gorn sends you southeast of Kargath to Camp Boff. Kill Tho’grun and bring back the Sign of the Earth. Gorn will be glad to see Tho’grun dead. The ogres no longer belong to the Horde.

quest:7828.text: Stalking the Stalkers. In Revantusk, Huntsman Markhor names the wolves threatening the village's hunters. He asks you to turn the hunt on them. The Hinterlands wilds have already claimed many trolls. Markhor counts Silvermane wolves among the greatest dangers to Revantusk's hunters. They hide among bushes and in the lay of the land, then pounce when the moment is right. He urges you to think as a Silvermane does and hunt the hunters. Every one must be put down. Markhor asks you to kill fifteen Silvermane Stalkers and fifteen Silvermane Howlers. They lurk in the Hinterlands wilds.

quest:7829.text: Hunt the Savages. In the Hinterlands, Huntsman Markhor sends you to hunt savage owlbeasts. He asks you to bring down twenty. Huntsman Markhor warns that savage owlbeasts are among the Hinterlands' most ornery creatures. Their claws and beaks have cost Revantusk many good warriors. He wants every owlbeast you see killed, until you can bear no more bloodshed. Then he will weigh and judge your contribution. Twenty must fall. Markhor counsels you to clear your mind of unclean thoughts and join with the wild. Savage owlbeasts roam the Hinterlands wilds.

quest:7830.text:
Avenging the Fallen. At Revantusk Village, Markhor turns his anger toward the Skylords. He asks you to slay a Razorbeak Skylord and bring him its plume. Huntsman Markhor of Revantusk Village resents the Wildhammer for training gryphons to slay trolls. He promises justice for the trolls, but first he wants you to strike at the Skylords, the Hinterlands' elder gryphons.

Slay a Razorbeak Skylord and bring its plume back to Markhor. This rare breed lives in the wilds of the Hinterlands. Markhor blames it for breeding murderous young.

quest:7839.text: Vilebranch Hooligans. In Revantusk Village, Smith Slagtree seeks tools stolen by Vilebranch trolls. A kind-hearted gnome gave him the set after saving his life when he was a young orc. Vilebranch trolls took Smith Slagtree's tools when they invaded Revantusk Village. He has spares, but the stolen set came from a kind-hearted gnome who saved his life when he was a young orc. The gift means the world to Slagtree, so he asks you to recover it. Markhor saw the tools near the temples of Agol'watha and Shaol'watha in the northeast of the Hinterlands. Slagtree also says to check Skulk Rock. The Vilebranch trolls there are ruthless and murderous.

quest:7840.text: Lard Lost His Lunch. In the Hinterlands, Lard has run to Revantusk and left the picnic lunch behind. A Vilebranch struck Lard at a private picnic, and now Lard asks you to fetch the food from an island to the north. A Vilebranch struck Lard with a big stick at a secret picnic spot. By Lard's account, the troll was ugly and mean. Lard fled to Revantusk, leaving the lunch behind and fearing a return. Lard's picnic spot lies on an island to the north. Lard hopes you will find the lunch and bring it back. Take care around the Vilebranch trolls.

quest:7841.text:
Message to the Wildhammer. At Revantusk Village, Otho Moji'ko wants a message carried to the Wildhammer dwarves. Their new allies include the high elves, and Otho wants his warning written in the blood of the Highvale high elves at Quel'Danil Lodge. The Wildhammer are making alliances with the trolls' enemies, and now the high elves stand with them. Otho Moji'ko spits at the thought. He wants the dwarves warned in the blood of their new friends. Slaughter every Highvale high elf you find and leave the bodies as a warning.

Highvale Outrunners, Scouts, Marksmen and Rangers gather at Quel'Danil Lodge, in the northwest of the Hinterlands.

quest:7842.text: Another Message to the Wildhammer. At Revantusk Village, Otho Moji'ko sends another message to the Wildhammer. He sees their bond with gryphons as close as a troll and a mate, and means to turn it against them. After the Highvale high elves, Otho Moji'ko has another message for the Wildhammer. Their closeness with gryphons disgusts him, but he sees a use for it. Kill the gryphons you meet across the Hinterlands and gather their Long Elegant Feathers. Gryphons live in every region there. Otho will make his final message from the feathers.

quest:7843.text: The Final Message to the Wildhammer. At Revantusk Village, Otho Moji'ko sends you west with a blood-soaked spear bound in gryphon feathers. The Wildhammer dwarves will find it planted beside the well at Aerie Peak's heart. After Another Message to the Wildhammer, Otho Moji'ko gives you a spear soaked in blood and bound with gryphon feathers. Carry it west to Aerie Peak and plant it beside the well at the town's heart. The Wildhammer dwarves will see that the trolls mean business. Furious dwarves and rowdy Alliance folk await you there, and Otho hopes you return alive.

quest:7844.text: Cannibalistic Cousins. In the Hinterlands, Mystic Yayo'jin asks you to strike at the Vilebranch near their temples. She calls them a depraved lot who prey on other trolls and humanoids. With Zul'jin away, the Revantusk are left to their own devices. Three troll tribes share the Hinterlands, though Mystic Yayo'jin says little binds them. The Vilebranch prey on other trolls and humanoids. Zul'jin could wipe them out with ease, but he is away. So the Revantusk are left to their own devices. Yayo'jin asks you to destroy the Vilebranch Scalpers and Soothsayers near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples. The temples lie in the Hinterlands' north by northeast.

quest:7845.text: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!. At Revantusk Village, Primal Torntusk asks you to save her mate after a bold midnight raid. Her spies say Elder Torntusk is alive atop Jintha'alor. Vilebranch savages struck Revantusk Village at midnight and seized Elder Torntusk, Primal Torntusk's mate. Her spies say he is alive, held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital in the southern Hinterlands. Primal Torntusk fears the village could not bear to lose him. Vile Priestess Hexx is said to be preparing Elder Torntusk for sacrifice to Hakkar, the faceless blood God.

quest:7846.text: Recover the Key!. At Jintha'alor, Elder Torntusk is shackled and asks you to free him. Hitah'ya the Keeper holds his key in a guarded cave nearby. After Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!, you find Elder Torntusk shackled at Jintha'alor. Hitah'ya the Keeper keeps the key to his bindings in a nearby cave, where she is well guarded. Elder Torntusk asks you to kill her and bring back the key. Then he can loosen his shackles and return home.

quest:7847.text: Return to Primal Torntusk. Elder Torntusk is free and sends you to Revantusk Village with word for his mate, Primal Torntusk. Elder Torntusk is free of his bindings and asks you to return to Revantusk Village. Tell his mate, Primal Torntusk, that he is coming home.

quest:7849.text: Separation Anxiety. Huntsman Markhor grieves for his twin, Malkhor, in Revantusk Village. The Vilebranch took Malkhor in the raid that took Torntusk's mate. Markhor believes Malkhor's soul can still be rescued, though his life is beyond saving. So he asks you to recover the remains. Many in Revantusk Village have lost loved ones to the wilds, Markhor says. His own grief is for his twin brother, Malkhor. The Vilebranch took Malkhor in the raid that took Torntusk's mate. His captors killed him swiftly and brutally; he was not fated to live. The Vilebranch fed Malkhor's remains to their oozes and wolves. Near the top of the temple of Jintha'alor are a refuse pit filled with oozes and a wolf den. His bones rest in a sludge pit near the top tier, while his skull lies on the tier itself. Markhor plans to carry the remains to Yayo'jin, who will prepare them for a proper burial.

quest:7850.text: Dark Vessels. In Revantusk Village, Primal Torntusk says the Vilebranch fight with a fury beyond the natural. He blames Vile Priestess Hexx's foul magic and asks you to take the tainted blood vessels from Jintha'alor, so he can cleanse them. Across Jintha'alor, tainted blood vessels bear the power of the faceless blood God. That power strengthens the Vilebranch and drives them mad. Torntusk believes taking the vessels away and cleansing them will loosen the blood God's grip on the trolls.

quest:7861.text: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions. Primal Torntusk has sent you to Jintha'alor to bring Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions to justice. He offers a grand prize for slaying Hexx and her elite Aman'zasi guard. Primal Torntusk sends you after Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions. They are atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands, where Hexx's elite Aman'zasi guards stand with her. Slay them, then report to Torntusk at Revantusk Village.

quest:7862.text: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village. Revantusk Village needs a new leader for its guard. Applicants must prove themselves against four kinds of Vilebranch and bring an application to Primal Torntusk. Guard Captain Malkhor has been lost, leaving Revantusk's guard without a captain once more. The notice calls on anyone who wants to lead the guard to complete its work and send an application to Primal Torntusk. To seek the captaincy, defeat Vilebranch Berserkers, Shadow Hunters, Blood Drinkers and Soul Eaters. Then return to Primal Torntusk in Revantusk Village.

quest:793.text:
Broken Alliances. Gorn sends you east into Lethlor Ravine to free two black drakes bound by the Seal of the Earth. This follows the first Broken Alliances. Three runestones keep the Seal of the Earth closed, one in each of Lethlor Ravine’s Diamond, Opal and Amethyst pillars. Gorn gives you the Sign of the Earth, which draws the stones out and opens the seal.

Countless drakes live in the ravine, and Blacklash and Hematus are formidable foes. Gorn wants both dead, with their bindings brought back to him.

quest:82.text: Noxious Lair Investigation. In the Noxious Lair, Centipaar bugs drain the pools that once lay there. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser wants to learn who the enemy is, so you bring five insect parts to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan for examination. After the Gadgetzan Water Survey, Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser turns to reports of the bugs. They drain the pools that once lay where the Noxious Lair now stands. He knows little about them and wants to learn who the enemy is, so you gather five parts from the Centipaar in the Noxious Lair. Then you take them to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan for examination.

quest:8241.text: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Iron. In the Searing Gorge, fiery flux is running low, and Master Smith Burninate needs more. After What the Flux?, Burninate asks for scales, iron bars, and coal, and will take all you can offer. Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux as the supply runs low. In the Searing Gorge, Burninate asks you for two incendosaur scales, four iron bars, and coal. All you can offer will be taken.

quest:8242.text: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather. In the Searing Gorge, Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux supplies. After What the Flux?, he asks you for two incendosaur scales, ten pieces of heavy leather, and coal. Bring all you can offer. Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux in the Searing Gorge. The supply is running low, so he asks you for two incendosaur scales, ten pieces of heavy leather, and coal. Bring all you can offer.

quest:8273.text: Oran's Gratitude. You bring Oran Snakewrithe a tablet, and Rin'ji's chain reaches its end. After Rin'ji's Secret, you carry the tablet to Oran Snakewrithe. You place it in his hands.

quest:836.text: Rescue OOX-09/HL!. Beyond Overlook Cliff, OOX-09/HL needs your help reaching the shore. Oglethorpe Obnoticus speaks through the fallen robot and asks you to escort it there. He waits in Booty Bay afterward. Oglethorpe's voice crackles from the robot again. OOX-09/HL needs an open, safe place for its lengthy take-off procedure, and the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff will do. Its built-in cloaking cannot yet be used. Oglethorpe needs time to make it work again. When OOX-09/HL reaches the shore safely, Oglethorpe Obnoticus asks you to speak with him in Booty Bay.

quest:841.text: Another Power Source?. In Gadgetzan, Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle offers you another power source for ten Wastewander Water Pouches. Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle believes the first power source ran out of time or was lost in the sand. Whatever happened, he has another one to sell you. Times are tough all around, so he asks for ten Wastewander Water Pouches.

quest:8551.text: The Captain's Chest. Smotts' lost chest lies with a sea giant after a wreck near Booty Bay. Captain Hecklebury Smotts once sailed between Booty Bay and Ratchet in Kalimdor. Sea giants wrecked his ship and killed the crew, then sent him toward Booty Bay in a lifeboat. Gorlash took his Captain's Chest, and now Smotts wants it back. Captain Hecklebury Smotts once sailed between Booty Bay and Ratchet in Kalimdor, and earned a fine reputation. Then sea giants smashed his ship and killed the crew. They sent Smotts toward Booty Bay in a lifeboat, and he left his voyages and good name behind. Gorlash took Smotts' Captain's Chest, saying he wanted it for a snuffbox. The chest was Smotts' favorite, and a secret compartment held his greatest treasures. Smotts has heard that Gorlash roams the shore east of Booty Bay.

quest:8552.text: The Monogrammed Sash. In Stranglethorn Vale, a lost sash bears initials that may lead to its owner. Finding the seafarer who lost it leads on to The Captain's Cutlass. You find a fine sash with the initials HS embroidered along its hem. Those two letters are the only clue to who lost it.

quest:8553.text: The Captain's Cutlass. Aboard Smotts' Revenge, Captain Hecklebury Smotts faces defeat at sea once more. Sea giants smash his second ship, kill its crew, and take his cutlass. He sends you to Sprogger, his former cook, to find the behemoth. After losing his first ship, Captain Hecklebury Smotts bought another and named it Smotts' Revenge. He gathered a new crew and provisions to hunt the sea giants who took his first vessel. The giants smashed the ship and killed the crew. Once more, Smotts was left adrift in a lifeboat, and Negolash took his cutlass in the attack. Captain Hecklebury Smotts wants his stolen cutlass back, so he turns to Sprogger. Sprogger was the cook aboard Smotts' Revenge and survived the attack. He can help you track down Negolash.

quest:8555.text: The Charge of the Dragonflights. In Tanaris, Anachronos meets you as the first part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands draws to a close. The chain leads toward the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Anachronos meets you in Tanaris to close the first part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands. The chain leads toward the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

quest:8576.text: Translating the Ledger. You bring Azuregos's ledger to Narain Soothfancy, who must decipher its writing. What he finds may bring you closer to opening the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Azuregos's ledger is in your hands, and Narain Soothfancy must decipher it. You bring the ledger to him so he can learn what Azuregos wrote.

quest:8577.text: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.. Narain cannot translate anything without the scrying goggles. Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F., has them, and you need to bring them back. Narain Soothfancy cannot translate anything without the scrying goggles. Stewvul was once Narain's best friend forever, but stole them a while ago. Then Stewvul broke Narain's heart in five places and abandoned Narain here. Narain's crystal ball points to two places where Stewvul might be. One is the Greymane Wall in Silverpine. The other lies beyond a portal. You need to find Stewvul and bring back the goggles.

quest:8584.text: Never Ask Me About My Business. Narain Soothfancy sends you to Gadgetzan to find a chicken weighing five hundred pounds. At the inn, Dirge Quikcleave can point you toward one. Narain Soothfancy wants no more questions about his business. It deals in things beyond your understanding, so he keeps the plan to himself and leaves the fetching to you. He needs a chicken weighing five hundred pounds. Dirge Quikcleave at the Gadgetzan inn can point you toward one.

quest:8586.text: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops. In Gadgetzan, Dirge Quikcleave has his recipe ready, but the meat needs attention soon. He asks you for twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt before it spoils. Dirge Quikcleave handles the spices himself, while the meat you brought him makes up the rest of the dish. He still needs twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt. With both in hand, the chicken can go back to Narain Soothfancy. Dirge urges you to hurry before the meat goes bad.

quest:8587.text: Return to Narain. Dirge Quikcleave keeps his word, and you carry his five-hundred-pound chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris. Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops came before this delivery. Dirge Quikcleave hands over the chicken he promised. A goblin keeps his word, he says. He cannot guess why a gnome wants a bird that size, and grumbles that it must be for sleeping in. From there, you carry the chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quest:8597.text:
Draconic for Dummies. Narain Soothfancy wants you to find the book he hid on an island in the South Seas. First, find his crashed gyrocopter on Land's End Beach, then swim south. This follows Translating the Ledger. Narain Soothfancy says the book will come in handy, and he hid it where no one could hope to find it. He took a gyrocopter to reach the hiding place, then crashed on the beach on his way back. Narain says the crash gave him his super-gnomish psychic powers.

The wreck lies somewhere along Land's End Beach. From there, swim south. Narain is sure you will recognise the place at a glance. The book lies buried on an island in the South Seas.

quest:8598.text: rAnS0m. At the freshly dug dirt in Tanaris, Narain Soothfancy’s book is gone, and a ransom note waits in its place. You carry the letter back to Narain after searching for the book in Draconic for Dummies. Made from scraps of type, the ransom note tells Narain Soothfancy that its writers have his precious book. They call him a gnome and promise he will see it again only if he follows their orders exactly. Three pages give detailed instructions, ending with a demand that he bring the money and come alone. You carry the letter to Narain in Tanaris.

quest:8599.text: Love Song for Narain. Meridith sends her love to Narain Soothfancy, and you carry her letter to him in Tanaris. She rescued the gnome from a crashed flying machine and asks you to seek his book, Draconic for Dummies. Meridith the Mermaiden seldom has visitors. Her last was the gnome she rescued from a crashed flying machine. The memory takes her gaze far away for a moment. Then she asks if you know Narain Soothfancy. She needs to tell him how she feels, and she is sure it is love. Meridith begs you to carry her message to him and promises to be forever in your debt.

quest:8606.text: Decoy!. At the Winterspring handover, Narain Soothfancy means to deliver the ransom after a fashion. You carry Narain's disguise to the spot the booknappers named, following the ransom letter. The ransom note said Narain should make the delivery himself. He plans to do so after a fashion, and chooses you for the part. His special kit holds a turban, a robe, and a sack filled with rocks. You carry the disguise to the handover spot the booknappers named in Winterspring. When they arrive for the goods, Narain wants them snuffed out as a lesson in what comes of crossing him.

quest:8728.text: The Good News and The Bad News. Narain Soothfancy has read the ledger and found good news and bad. He is nearly certain he can build the arcanite buoy you specified, but needs arcanite, elementium ore, and fine gems. The chicken, the goggles, and the second Draconic For Dummies book must all be done first. Narain Soothfancy studies the ledger and murmurs under his breath. He is ninety-nine percent sure he can build the arcanite buoy to your specifications. The materials are the bad news. He asks for twenty arcanite bars, ten elementium ore, ten Azerothian diamonds, and ten blue sapphires. Bring them, and he will craft the buoy.

quest:8742.text: The Might of Kalimdor. In Tanaris, Anachronos greets you in The Might of Kalimdor as the champion fate has awaited for a thousand years. He sees you leading your people into a new age. The Blue, Green and Red Scepter Shard forks are complete, bringing the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to its end. Anachronos speaks of a fate a thousand years in the making. The Old God trembles at your coming and fears your faith. Anachronos urges you to break C'Thun's prophecy, and you bring Kalimdor's strength with you. When you are ready, tell Anachronos, and he will place the Scepter of the Shifting Sands in your hands.

quest:8921.text:
The Ectoplasmic Distiller. In Gadgetzan, Mux Manascrambler lacks the funds and help to finish his extra-dimensional ghost revealer. He asks you for costly materials and forty gold to build its first piece, an ectoplasmic distiller. Mux Manascrambler welcomes your help with his ghost revealer, a machine meant to reach across dimensions. First, he needs a distiller to gather the fabric of death itself. Building it will be difficult. Mux asks for one delicate arcanite converter, four greater eternal essences, ten stonescale oil, twenty-five volcanic ash, and forty gold.

The volcanic ash must come from the lava pools of the Burning Steppes. It will make the distiller's filter. The materials are costly, but Mux says he needs every one.

quest:8922.text: A Supernatural Device. Deliana needs a way to speak with Anthion Harmon's ghost. You carry the collected blood to an engineer in Gadgetzan as payment for a device that speaks with the dead. Deliana seeks a way to reach Anthion Harmon, or rather his ghost. She has Mux Manascrambler in mind, an engineer who claims to have a machine for speaking with the dead. The blood you collected was meant for him all along. Carry it to Mux in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris, and give it to him for his services.

quest:8923.text: A Supernatural Device. In Gadgetzan, Mokvar sends you with venom for an engineer studying the dead. Mux Manascrambler is building a device to speak with them, and Mokvar hopes it can reach Anthion. Mokvar says you have shown courage by staying on, and more armor awaits those still willing to help. The venom you gathered is for Mux Manascrambler, an engineer who studies the supernatural and knows Mokvar. Mux is building a device to speak with the dead. Mokvar hopes it can reach Anthion and reveal more about his own situation. Carry the sealed container to Mux in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris.

quest:8924.text:
Hunting for Ectoplasm. Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan has his distiller ready, and now needs ectoplasm. You carry it to Silithus, Winterspring and the Eastern Plaguelands, gathering twelve of each kind from the incorporeal dead. This follows The Ectoplasmic Distiller. Mux Manascrambler is proud of his distiller, but the incorporeal dead are far from Gadgetzan. He believes climate changes the spectral fabric of the dead. In Silithus, tortured night elves yield scorched ectoplasm. In Winterspring, spirits of the highborne yield frozen ectoplasm.

Ghosts and banshees in the Eastern Plaguelands yield stable ectoplasm. Gather twelve of each kind. Mux says to set the distiller down nearby before harvesting, then bring it and the ectoplasm back to Gadgetzan.

quest:8925.text: A Portable Power Source. Mux Manascrambler needs steady power for his ectoplasm. Rumour points to Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, whose heart is a Magma Core, and Mux asks you to bring it to Gadgetzan. Mux Manascrambler needs power he can carry to keep the ectoplasm active. Rumour says Magma Lord Bokk, a mighty elemental, has a Magma Core for a heart. Its heat never ends. Bokk is said to dwell in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain and west of the Pillar of Ash. Mux wants you to bring the core to Gadgetzan to run his extra-dimensional ghost revealer.

quest:8928.text:
A Shifty Merchant. In Gadgetzan, Mux Manascrambler has a core for his device but still needs a rod to carry its force without melting. He remembers an imp in Winterspring who offered an elemental rod, and regrets not buying it. You find the imp in a cave at Darkwhisper Gorge’s entrance and buy the Fel Elemental Rod. Mux Manascrambler has the core for his device, but still needs a rod that can carry its force without melting. After A Portable Power Source, he recalls an elemental rod an imp was selling in Winterspring. Mux regrets not buying it then.

The imp is in a cave at the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring. You buy the Fel Elemental Rod and bring it to Mux in Gadgetzan. He says the imp quoted him forty gold and insists you pay no more.

quest:992.text: Gadgetzan Water Survey. Gadgetzan needs water, and Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser is searching the desert for a new source. The Gadgetzan Water Company has lost every well to the nomads, so Fizzledowser hires you to sample a pool near Sandsorrow Watch. The Gadgetzan Water Company has lost every well to the nomads. Now Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser hopes to find other free sources in the desert, but the search calls for a survey. The company needs a temporary junior-grade surveyor to help. Fizzledowser gives you an untapped dowsing widget and sends you to the pool near Sandsorrow Watch. It lies due west of Gadgetzan and south of Zul'Farrak, within view of nearby trolls. Use the widget to tap a water sample, then return it to Fizzledowser.
